title: Score Sheet
statement: A quiz host keeps a score sheet. You get the host's notes in order as an array `notes`. A whole number adds a new score. `D` adds double the last score. `S` adds the sum of the last two scores. `X` crosses out the last score. Every note is valid (there are always enough scores). Return the sum of the scores still on the sheet.

keyPoints: Every note works on the most recent scores: keep them on a stack
A number pushes it; D pushes twice the top; S pushes the sum of the top two; X pops

hints: Which scores do D, S, and X look at?
They only use the latest scores, so a stack fits.
Push, double the top, add the top two, or pop; then add up the stack.
